{{Top|leg}}
The '''Moonbeam Throne''' was the ceremonial throne used by [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Supreme Overlord]] [[Shimrra Jamaane]] in his [[Shimrra's Citadel|Citadel]]. The throne was surrounded by a [[Blood/Legends|blood]] moat and an unusual [[dovin basal]].<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>
